categories.name: utils
categories.evidence: Modifies BIP-352 Silent Payments shared helper library in src/common/bip352.cpp
categories.rationale: Fixes a vulnerability where malleated P2PKH scriptSigs cause Silent Payments recipients to extract the wrong public key and miss payments. As noted in the description, third-party malleation under DUMMY_CHECKER leaves an incorrect pubkey on the stack, preventing recipients from detecting transactions paying them.
